batch_window.value: CBBIL05J: due out 07:00; CBCRD10J: due out 06:00; CBPRT04J: due out 23:59; CBREF05J: due out 20:00
batch_window.basis: TIMEFROM / TIMEUNTIL / DUE OUT of the scheduler definitions (scheduling times, not measured elapsed)

compiler.basis: build tool of the module's compile steps (BUILD_TOOLS)

compiler_options.basis: PARM= of the module's compile steps

copybook_library_concatenation.basis: SYSLIB concatenation of the module's compile steps

db2_plans.basis: RUN PROGRAM(...) PLAN(...) cards and BIND statements in the scanned JCL

db2_subsystem.basis: DSN SYSTEM(...) / SSID in the scanned JCL (connections.json db2.subsystems)

dynamic_call_convention.value: 14 dynamic call site(s) (CICS-LINK), 14 resolved by literal assignment, 0 open
dynamic_call_convention.basis: dyncalls.json: the call-name ladder the dynamic-call pass walked

load_library_concatenation.basis: STEPLIB / JOBLIB / DSN RUN LIB concatenation of the module's steps

non_relational_stores.basis: dataset classification and DL/I / IDMS evidence in connections.json

transaction_monitor.basis: EXEC CICS / DL/I evidence in connections.json (batch-only modules have none)

asks.message: PARTYRSK profile: database_managers reads IBM Db2 for z/OS from this module's store, which is what this module proves and not what the estate has — which database systems the estate runs, and at which level
asks.request: List the database systems installed (Db2, IMS DL/I, IDMS, Adabas, ...) with their versions: the scan proves only what this module touches, which is a lower bound

asks.message: PARTYRSK profile: db2_library_level is not in the store — which DB2 level the module is built and run against
asks.request: Provide the DB2 library concatenation (SDSNLOAD / SDSNEXIT) of the module's steps, which names the DB2 level

asks.message: PARTYRSK profile: environment_topology is not in the store — which LPARs and environments (production / test / DR) the estate has — the scanned JCL allocates datasets under the high-level qualifier(s) ASM, CARD, CICS, CICSTS, DSN, PRTY, SYS1, SYS2: a naming observation, which is not proof of which LPAR or environment runs them
asks.request: State the LPARs and environments, how a dataset or job name says which one it belongs to, and which sysplex they sit in: the scan can only list the qualifiers it saw

asks.message: PARTYRSK profile: file_transfer is not in the store — how files cross the boundary of the estate — assumed 'IBM Connect:Direct' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the file-transfer product (Connect:Direct, FTP/SFTP, XCOM, MFT) used to move datasets in and out

asks.message: PARTYRSK profile: interfaces is not in the store — what the module exchanges with the world outside it
asks.request: Confirm the module's interfaces (modules it calls but does not own, MQ, remote systems, transfers) and who owns the other side

asks.message: PARTYRSK profile: library_manager is not in the store — which source / change manager holds the members — assumed 'Broadcom Endevor' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the source library manager (Endevor, ChangeMan, Panvalet, Librarian, plain PDS) and how a member is promoted to production

asks.message: PARTYRSK profile: masking_policy is not in the store — what may leave the estate, and in what shape
asks.request: State the data-masking policy for extracted test data (which fields must be masked, whether production data may leave the estate at all)

asks.message: PARTYRSK profile: online_monitors reads IBM CICS Transaction Server from this module's store, which is what this module proves and not what the estate has — which transaction monitors the estate runs, and at which level
asks.request: List the online monitors installed (CICS TS, IMS TM, none) with their versions: the scan proves only what this module uses, which is a lower bound

asks.message: PARTYRSK profile: output_manager is not in the store — which product owns the printed output once it leaves the spool — 76 DD(s) write to SYSOUT: the jobs print, but a spool class never names the product that archives or delivers the output — assumed 'Broadcom CA View' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the output / report manager (CA View, CA Deliver, Control-D, CA Spool) and what it does with each SYSOUT class the jobs write to

asks.message: PARTYRSK profile: security_manager is not in the store — which external security manager guards the datasets — assumed 'IBM RACF' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the security manager (RACF, CA ACF2, CA Top Secret) and who owns the dataset profiles

asks.message: PARTYRSK profile: shared_code_boundary is not in the store — which code the module uses but does not own
asks.request: Confirm which copybooks and called modules are shared estate code rather than the module's own, and which library owns them

asks.message: PARTYRSK profile: sort_product is not in the store — which sort product PGM=SORT resolves to — 3 step(s) run PGM=SORT, the site linkage alias: a sort runs, the product is unnamed — assumed 'IBM DFSORT' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the sort product installed (IBM DFSORT or Syncsort MFX): PGM=SORT is a linkage alias and does not say which one runs

asks.message: PARTYRSK profile: standard_compiler is not in the store — which compiler the shop builds production code with — assumed 'IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.3' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the shop-standard compiler and release (Enterprise COBOL 6.x, ...); a single module's compile step is that module's, not the estate's

asks.message: PARTYRSK profile: standard_compiler_options is not in the store — which compile options the shop builds production code with — assumed 'RENT,NUMPROC(NOPFD),TRUNC(STD),ARCH(8),SSRANGE(NO)' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the shop-standard compile options (NUMPROC, TRUNC, ARCH, RENT, SSRANGE, ...) a module is expected to be built with

asks.message: PARTYRSK profile: tape_manager is not in the store — which tape manager owns the volumes the jobs allocate — assumed 'Broadcom CA 1' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the tape / removable-media manager (CA 1, CA TLMS, DFSMSrmm) and the retention rules it applies: UNIT=TAPE proves tape is used, never which catalogue owns it

asks.message: PARTYRSK profile: test_lpar is not in the store — whether a test LPAR is available to run the migrated code against
asks.request: Confirm whether a test LPAR (or a sandbox subsystem) is available for parallel runs, and who can grant access

asks.message: PARTYRSK profile: volumes is not in the store — how much data the module moves per run
asks.request: Provide the production volumes (records in / out per run, DB2 row counts, file sizes) the module handles

asks.message: PARTYRSK profile: zos_version is not in the store — which z/OS release the estate runs — assumed 'IBM z/OS 2.5' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the z/OS release of the production LPAR (D IPLINFO, or the release the shop is on)
